notes: Two therein fusions are read as single units under rule 22 rather than as an unrepresented suffix beside a rendered preposition.
The supplied these things is kept inside כֹּל's unit under rule 31; the alternative added reading is named in that unit's note.

אֲבֵדָה → that which was lost follows rule 46's closing rider for a noun the ASV recasts as a headless relative; the article on אָדָם is unrepresented because the ASV writes a man, and the indefinite article belongs to the noun under rule 15.
